name: Jumby Bay Island Resort
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive private island sanctuary is where Caribbean luxury reaches its zenith, accessible only by boat and reserved for guests and resort staff alone.
whats_special: Jumby Bay spans an entire 300-acre private island just 2 miles off Antigua's coast. The resort is famous for its pristine Pasture Bay Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches, and its unique position as a car-free island where bicycles and golf carts are the only transportation. The property sits on protected land that's home to endangered hawksbill turtles who nest directly on the resort's beaches.
pro_tip: Visit during turtle nesting season (June-October) for the magical experience of watching baby hawksbills make their first journey to the sea, guided by resort naturalists.
dont_miss: The signature Estate House restaurant housed in an 18th-century plantation mansion, and the weekly beach barbecue where lobsters are grilled directly on the sand. Take the complimentary island tour to discover ancient Arawak petroglyphs and visit the island's organic herb garden that supplies the resort's restaurants.
pros: Pristine white sand beaches and turquoise waters
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
